findings.detail: Uses db.WithTx for transactional team creation including units and repo additions

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: none - all within single DB transaction

findings.detail: Uses db.WithTx for team update + unit replacement + access recalculation
No external calls, but large teams with many repos could have long-running transactions
findings.recommendation: Consider adding a repo count check before recalculating all access

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Long transaction could hold locks if team has many repos

findings.detail: Large transaction: loads members, updates branch protections, removes repos, deletes records, removes invalid org users - all in one tx
findings.recommendation: Transaction is correct but could be very long-running for large teams

findings.detail: No timeout on the transaction. A team with many repos and members could take significant time
findings.recommendation: Consider breaking into smaller transactions or adding progress tracking

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Long-running transaction could cause lock contention

findings.detail: AddOrgUser and team_user insert are in separate transactions. Auto-watch is async.
findings.recommendation: The two-phase approach (AddOrgUser then AddTeamMember) has a small window where user is in org but not in team if second tx fails

findings.detail: Adding an already-existing member is a no-op (checks IsTeamMember first)

non_atomic_operations: AddOrgUser and team_user insert are separate transactions
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Auto-watch goroutine failure only logged, doesn't affect response
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Auto-watch failures are logged but don't fail the request

findings.detail: Single transaction covers: membership removal, access recalculation per repo, watch removal, issue reassignment, org user cleanup
findings.recommendation: Transaction is correct but could be long for teams with many repos

findings.detail: Removing a non-member returns nil (no error), making it idempotent

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Long transaction for teams with many repos

rate_limiting.detail: No rate limiting on team endpoints
rate_limiting.recommendation: Add rate limiting especially for write operations
